title: Sr QA Automation Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Role: Senior QA Automation Engineer Location: India, Remote Experience: 6+ Years 
 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a hands-on Senior Automation QA Engineer with strong expertise in Playwright, TypeScript, and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) to strengthen our automation QA practice across multiple analytics-driven web applications. The candidate will be responsible for expanding automation coverage and building a scalable, reusable automation framework across products. Strong experience in UI and API automation, Cucumber-based BDD, Azure DevOps CI/CD integration, and automated validation of analytics and dashboard workflows is essential. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 UI API Test Automation 
 Design, develop, and maintain UI and API automation suites using Playwright and TypeScript. Automate critical workflows across analytics-driven web applications and dashboards. Develop reliable automated tests for functional, integration, and regression scenarios. Validate application behaviour across different workflows and identify defects early. Ensure automation coverage focuses on high-value business-critical scenarios. 
 
 BDD Automation Framework Development 
 Implement Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) automation using Cucumber. Develop and maintain reusable page objects, services, utilities, and automation components. Build scalable and maintainable automation frameworks that can be reused across multiple products. Follow automation design principles and coding best practices. Contribute to framework enhancements, standardisation, and continuous improvement. 
 
 Analytics Data Validation 
 Automate critical analytics, reporting, and dashboard workflows. Validate UI data against API responses and database results. Verify data consistency, accuracy, and integrity across application layers. Collaborate with development and QA teams to identify suitable data-driven automation scenarios. Investigate discrepancies between UI displays, API responses, and underlying data. 
 
 Azure DevOps CI/CD Integration 
 Integrate automated test suites with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. Support automated test execution as part of continuous integration and delivery workflows. Configure and maintain automation execution processes within pipeline environments. Analyse test execution results and investigate pipeline failures. Improve automation reliability and support efficient release validation. 
 
 Test Reporting Troubleshooting 
 Maintain test execution reporting using Allure. Analyse automation failures and perform root-cause analysis. Debug flaky tests, locator issues, and failures involving dynamic web applications. Identify and resolve automation framework and test execution issues. Communicate test results, defects, risks, and recommendations to relevant stakeholders. 
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Continuous Improvement 
 Collaborate with QA engineers and development teams to identify high-value automation opportunities. Participate in test planning, scenario reviews, and discussions on automation strategy. Contribute to automation standards, framework improvements, and QA best practices. Support automation coverage across multiple applications and product environments. Mentor junior QA engineers and share knowledge where required. 
 
 Required Technical Skills Competencies 
 6+ years of experience in QA Automation. 4+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright. Strong proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript. Hands-on experience implementing BDD automation using Cucumber. Experience developing UI and API automation suites. Experience integrating automated tests with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. Strong understanding of locator strategies and handling dynamic web applications. Experience building reusable automation frameworks, page objects, services, and utilities. Experience validating UI data against API responses and database results. Familiarity with Allure reporting and automated test result analysis. Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. 
 
 Must-Have Skills 
 Playwright TypeScript JavaScript Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) Cucumber UI Automation Testing API Automation Validation Azure DevOps CI/CD Pipeline Integration Locator Strategies Dynamic Web Application Testing Reusable Automation Frameworks Page Object Model Test Reporting Failure Analysis Debugging Root-Cause Analysis 
 
 Good to Have Skills 
 SQL for data validation Database testing and data integrity validation Allure reporting Experience with analytics-driven applications and dashboards Experience working across multiple applications and product environments
